name: kexec_file_load
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_kexec_file_load, int kernel_fd, int initrd_fd, unsigned long cmdline_len, const char *cmdline, unsigned long flags);
description: The kexec_file_load() system call loads a new kernel for later execution using file descriptors. It requires specifying the kernel image, optional initrd image, command line, and flags to control the loading process.

parameters.name: kernel_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the kernel image file.

parameters.name: initrd_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the initrd image file, or -1 if not used.

parameters.name: cmdline_len
parameters.description: Length of the command line string.

parameters.name: cmdline
parameters.description: Pointer to the command line string for the new kernel.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bit mask of flags to control the operation, such as architecture or other options.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The specified region lies outside the reserved memory for the crash kernel or is not page-aligned.
kernel_fd or initrd_fd is not a valid file descriptor.
Another crash kernel is already being loaded or in use.
Invalid flags, mismatched buffer sizes, overlapping buffers, or other invalid arguments.
The kernel file is not loadable, such as not being a valid bzImage.
The caller does not have the CAP_SYS_BOOT capability.
